artifact.title: Product Requirements Document
artifact.snippet: The system shall provide an interactive interface for users to take generated quizzes. Users can select answers for quiz questions and the system shall provide immediate feedback on answer correctness.

artifact.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
artifact.snippet: The Next.js Frontend is a single-page application built with React and Next.js, styled with Tailwind CSS. It communicates with the Supabase backend for data, authentication, and storage, and with the Vercel Function for AI-powered features.

artifact.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
artifact.snippet: Purpose: To provide an engaging, clear, and interactive environment for users to take quizzes generated from their study materials. It guides them through questions, collects answers, and provides immediate or summary feedback.

artifact.title: ibe160 - Epic Breakdown
artifact.snippet: As a user, I want to take generated quizzes through an interactive interface, so that I can actively test my understanding. Acceptance Criteria: Given I have a generated quiz, When I start the quiz, Then I can select answers for each question, And the system provides immediate feedback on whether my answer is correct or incorrect.

artifact.title: Epic Technical Specification: AI-Powered Learning Tools
artifact.snippet: 1. User Action: User starts a generated quiz. 2. Frontend: Displays quiz questions and multiple-choice options. 3. User Action: User selects an answer. 4. Frontend: Provides immediate feedback on correctness. 5. User Action: User completes quiz. 6. Frontend: Displays overall score, motivational feedback, and explanations for each answer (correct/incorrect).

artifact.reason: Provides the main application layout and Supabase client setup, which the new quiz interface will live within.
Shows how the Supabase client is initialized, which might be necessary for fetching quiz data.

constraints.constraint: The UI should be clean, simple, and accessible, following the established design system (shadcn/ui).
The quiz interface must be responsive and work well on different screen sizes.
All user data must be protected by Row Level Security (RLS) in Supabase.
Must adhere to WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance.

tests.standards: Unit and integration tests will be written using Jest and React Testing Library. Tests should cover component rendering, user interactions, and state changes.

ideas.idea: Render the quiz interface and verify that the first question and its answers are displayed correctly. (AC: 1)
Simulate a user selecting an answer and verify that the component's state updates accordingly. (AC: 1)
Simulate selecting a correct answer and verify that immediate positive feedback is shown. (AC: 2)
Simulate selecting an incorrect answer and verify that immediate corrective feedback is shown. (AC: 2)
Test the quiz completion flow and the display of the final score. (AC: 1, 2)
